:::{#def-tuning-parameter}
#### Tuning parameter

A **tuning parameter** is a setting $\tuning$
that the analyst fixes before the model is fitted,
rather than one computed from the data,
and that selects one prediction function from a family:

$$
\predvalf{\predvar} = \candpredvalf{\tuning}{\predvar}.
$$ {#eq-tuning-parameter}

Source: @wikipedia_hyperparameter_machine_learning.
:::
